name: Cable Single-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand facing away from a low cable and hold its handle behind your head with one elbow pointing upward.
Extend the working elbow to lift your hand overhead.
Bend your elbow to guide your hand back behind your head.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your upper arm beside your ear.
Brace your core so your lower back does not arch as you extend overhead.
